```blitzbasic
AvailVidMem:Int32
```

**Returns:** The free video memory in bytes.

## Description

The amount of video memory that is free, in bytes. Every image and texture uses some of it.

## Differences

* The number is the memory budget the graphics driver reports for this program. It is cut off at 2 GB, because it has to fit into an integer. [AvailVidMem64](AvailVidMem64) is not cut off. It is 0 when no graphics window is open, and with the OpenGL renderer when the driver does not say.
